pages.title: Ephemeral Graviton Ore
pages.text: A vein where gravity itself fizzes. The quanta of the gravitational field appear and vanish here so densely that the ore feels slightly heavier one moment and lighter the next. Nearby dust drifts in slow, uneven arcs.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)No detector has ever caught a single graviton. Picking through foam substrate, I found a seam where my plumb line twitched in rhythm with bursts of vacuum noise. Borrowed gravitons, pinned in stone.
$(thing)Found$(): in veins through the Quantum Foam (mine it for its drop).
